serp.note: 2026 tier table: Free $0, Pro $18/mo or $144/yr, Teams $25/mo or $250/yr per seat, Enterprise custom. Pro = 141M assets, 100 GB, 5 Brand Kits; Teams = 500 GB, 100 Brand Kits, approval workflows. AI pool: Free ~50 lifetime text-to-image, Pro/Teams 500/mo text-to-image + 150 AI design + 50 text-to-video (differs from other sources). Flags 'hard ceiling mid-project' because add-on credits are not documented.

Free $0, Pro $15–18/mo (≈$12–15/mo annual), Business $20–25 per user/mo or $250/yr per seat. Confirms 'Canva Teams no longer exists as a flat-rate plan' and the September 2024 restructure to per-seat pricing. Pro: background remover, Magic Resize, 100M+ premium assets, Brand Kit. Business: shared brand controls, approval workflows, multi-user admin. Free is 'genuinely usable for casual creators'.

Pro $144/yr ($12/mo effective); Business $250/yr per person. Pro unlocks: 3.6M+ templates (vs 1.6M), 141M stock, 5 Brand Kits, 100 GB storage, 200 Premium or 20 Ultra monthly AI pooled. 'Standard AI tools on paid plans do not draw from your monthly allowance at all' — fair use for Background Remover, Magic Edit etc. Pro worth it for weekly designers, multi-brand managers; skip if occasional or Figma-centric. Flags Affinity acquisition reshaping budget design landscape.

Free $0, Pro $144/yr (~$12/mo), Business $250/yr/person, Enterprise custom. Storage ladder: 5 → 100 → 500 → 1,024 GB. Brand Kits: 1 (3 colors) / 5 / 100 / unlimited. AI pool shared: Free 20, Pro 200 Premium or 20 Ultra, Business 400 Premium or 40 Ultra. Add-on AI Pass $100/mo. Prices are 'web prices as of October 4, 2026'. 'Pro may fit people who make designs regularly and want premium assets, brand kits and the AI tools.'

14-day hands-on test (June 2026). Pro ≈$120/year ($15/mo monthly) — legacy/regional pricing. Three features that justify it: Background Remover (one-click, no masking), Magic Resize (one design → every format), Brand Kit (logos/colors/fonts consistency). 'Pro is worth roughly $120 a year if you design most weeks and lean on the Pro-only tools.' Skip Pro if occasional, already pay Adobe CC, need precise vector editing.

Free $0, Pro $144/yr ($12/mo), Business $250/yr per seat, Enterprise custom. Asset ladder: 4.7M → 141M assets, 1.6M → 3.6M templates (~30x expansion). Storage 5/100/500 GB. Brand Kits 1/5/100. AI monthly Free 20, Pro 200 Premium/20 Ultra, Business 400/40. Concrete worth-it threshold: 30+ product photos/month with background removal ≈ $0.30 per photo value. 'Pro is single-seat only — adding a second user requires Business upgrade (+73.6% cost).'

Pro $12.99/mo or $119.99/yr (effective ~$10/mo on annual) — another legacy/regional quote. Teams $10/mo per person annual for 3+. Features: Background Remover, Magic Resize, 100M+ premium stock, 1 TB storage claim (conflicts with other sources at 100 GB), 100+ Brand Kits (conflicts — Pro is 5, Business is 100). Author's verdict: pay if design 3+ weekly, manage multiple brands, multi-platform social. Stay free if infrequent, single brand.

Free $0 (1.6M templates, 5 GB), Pro $18/mo or $144/yr (~$12/mo annual, 100 GB), Business $25/mo or $250/yr per user (replaces discontinued Teams). Free: 1 Brand Kit. Pro: 5 Brand Kits + Background Remover + Magic Resize. Business: 100 Brand Kits + team approval workflows. AI: Free 20 Standard/Premium shared pool, Pro 200 Premium or 20 Ultra, Business 400/40. 'Standard AI tools don't count against paid plans at all.' Annual saves ~1/3 vs monthly. K-12 Canva for Education free; college via institution; nonprofits Pro + team tools free for 50 users.

Pro $18/mo or $144/yr, single-user. Free 4.7M+ assets vs Pro 141M+; 1.6M → 3.6M templates. Free Brand Kit limited to 3 colors; Pro has 5 unlimited kits. Free lacks SVG, transparent PNG, CMYK export, no bulk design, no scheduler, 5 GB vs 100 GB storage. Pro also has '10 times more AI usage' allocation. Upgrade if 'extensive control over output formats' or 'really large library of videos and stock images.'

Pro $15/mo monthly, $120/yr annual ($10/mo effective) — another source disagreement on headline price (vs $18/$144 majority). Annual saves 33% = $60/year. Features: Magic Write, Magic Edit, Magic Eraser, Brand Kit, Magic Resize, Background Remover, Content Planner. Worth it for freelancers, content creators, SMB marketing. Skip for casual users and students on basic projects.

Canva Pro $15/month verdict for marketing teams: 'one of the best-value subscriptions in marketing — if you use it for what it's built for.' 3.6M+ templates, 141M+ premium assets, Brand Kit (fonts + logos), AI design tools (Magic Edit, Background Remover, Magic Resize), video up to 60s 4K, real-time collaboration, 500 AI credits monthly (differs from pooled numbers in other sources — likely marketing-doc framing). Limitation: 'not a complete marketing platform' — no SEO, no keyword research, no competitor analysis.

Live canva.com/pricing page returns HTTP 403 to generic crawlers (anti-bot). The $18/mo, $144/yr, $25/mo, $250/yr figures used in the post are the ones that nine of eleven independent 2026 reviews opened for this breakdown agree on — reconfirm on canva.com at checkout before paying.
Canva Help Center also returns HTTP 403 to WebFetch. Billing details (annual vs monthly, per-seat Business, Teams-retirement) cross-checked against the eleven opened 2026 reviews instead.

factcheck.claim: Canva Pro 2026 list price is $18/month on monthly billing or $144/year on annual billing (~$12/month effective, ~33% annual discount) for a single seat, including 100 GB storage and 5 Brand Kits.

Canva Business/Teams in 2026 is per-seat ($25/mo or $250/yr per seat) — the flat-rate Teams plan was retired in September 2024 and replaced with per-seat Business pricing, representing a ~74% per-person step up from Pro.

Magic Studio monthly allowance on Canva Pro is 200 Premium uses OR 20 Ultra uses (one shared pool); Business is 400 Premium or 40 Ultra per seat; Free is capped around 20 Standard/Premium total. Standard AI tools (Background Remover, Magic Edit, Magic Grab) on paid plans do not draw from this pool.
Canva asset libraries scale from 4.7M+ free assets / 1.6M+ templates (Free) to 141M+ premium assets / 3.6M+ templates (Pro and Business) — roughly a 30x expansion.

Canva offers free Pro-equivalent access via Canva for Education (K-12 teachers/students through verified school accounts) and Canva for Nonprofits (Pro plus team tools free for one team of up to 50 users).
